ModelComparisonPage.benchmark_warning_text: Unified models (unified_*) use the unified_feature_contract_v2 CSV schema. Legacy models (full_canonical__lgbm, robust9_clean__lgbm) use the legacy benchmark CSV. Cross-schema comparison is not valid unless both models share the same input CSV.

final_research_outcome.headline: Unified feature contract reduced dataset fingerprinting but did not eliminate it.
final_research_outcome.detail: After fixing cross-dataset formula mismatches and selecting ratio/relative features, domain AUC dropped from 1.0000 (legacy) to 0.9591 (unified_relative_shape_v2__lgbm). This is a meaningful improvement, but a classifier can still identify the source dataset above chance. Further reduction may require domain-adversarial training (DANN) or more aggressive feature ablation.

domain_fingerprinting_story: Top fingerprinting culprits: sz_mean_max, iat_all_p75, sz_all_p75 (high domain importance in anti-fingerprint scoring).

lodo_negative_control_interpretation.LODO_ISCX: AUC = 0.637 — model trained without ISCX performs near-randomly on ISCX. This is the honest cross-domain failure mode.
lodo_negative_control_interpretation.LODO_VNAT: AUC = 0.956 — VNAT generalizes well from ISCX+USBVPN training.
lodo_negative_control_interpretation.interpretation: ISCX is the hardest held-out dataset. The model partially learns ISCX-specific patterns during full training (3-dataset), which explains the pooled AUC vs LODO gap.

RobustnessPage.live_validation_caveat: Live PCAP validation is schema-confirmed only. The unified extractor (unified_v2.0) has been verified to produce the correct 12 features from raw packet arrays. However, no end-to-end test with real live network traffic captured on the VM has been run. Before deploying to production, a live PCAP validation session must be completed.
what_is_not_solved: Domain fingerprinting: domain AUC = 0.9591 — still above 0.5 (random).
LODO-ISCX = 0.637: cross-domain transfer to ISCX-style traffic is limited.
ECE = 0.299: probability calibration is poor. Raw scores unreliable as probabilities.
USBVPN LODO: not computable (nearly all benign labels in USBVPN test set).
Live traffic validation: schema confirmed only. End-to-end live test pending.
GroupDRO / DANN: alternative training strategies not yet fully explored in unified pipeline.

LiveVMPage.extractor_compatibility_notes: The unified extractor (src/features/unified_extractor.py) produces the correct 12 features from raw packet arrays. However, live PCAP → feature extraction → model inference has not been validated end-to-end on real traffic. The extractor requires IP total length for packet sizes.
